docket_entries.description: THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DECHARMS, CHRIS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MCCALLION, LOUISE $10,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $170.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $10,170.00, DEFENDANT GAVE PLAINTIFF A CHECK DRAWN ON INSUFFICIENT FUNDS IN JULY 2011, AND TO DATE HAS FAILED AND REFUSED TO REFUND PLAINTIFF'S SECURITY DEPOSIT. INCLUDED IN THE JUDGMENT ARE STATUTORY DAMAGES IN THE AMOUNT OF $4,600.00 DUE TO DEFENDANT'S VIOLATION OF CIVIL CODE SECTION 1950.5 IN BAD FAITH. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
